hierarchical_bootstrap.deterministic_seed_rule: first 64 bits of SHA256 of immutable profile label, method name, resample count, and confidence
hierarchical_bootstrap.statistic: median of within-seed allocation medians, then median across resampled seeds
hierarchical_bootstrap.unit: matched allocation nested within training seed

result_policy: Sensitivity qualification only. The analysis erratum changes only allocation-level PyTorch base-release validation; it does not change samples, statistics, qualification policy, objective values, or any winner.
